questions.title: High-Traffic E-Commerce Product Catalog
questions.question:
Design a comprehensive caching and performance optimization strategy for an e-commerce product catalog system.

Requirements:
- System serves 100,000 products with images, prices, inventory, reviews
- Traffic: 200,000 requests/minute during peak (flash sales, Black Friday)
- Product data updates: prices change every 5 minutes, inventory in real-time, reviews continuously
- Search functionality: full-text search across products with filters (category, price range, ratings, availability)
- Personalization: product recommendations based on user history, prices may vary by user segment (B2B vs B2C)
- Multi-region deployment: US, EU, APAC with region-specific inventory and pricing
- Mobile clients: 70% of traffic, slow networks (2G/3G in some regions)
- Performance targets: P95 latency <200ms, 99.9% availability
- Cache hit rate target: >90% for product pages

Design:
1. Multi-layer caching strategy (browser, CDN, application, database)
2. Cache invalidation strategy for different data types (prices, inventory, reviews)
3. Handling cache consistency across regions
4. Optimizing for personalized content while maintaining high cache hit rates
5. Database query optimization and indexing strategy
6. HTTP optimization (compression, HTTP/2, ETags)
7. Image optimization and delivery strategy
8. Handling cache stampede during flash sales
9. Search result caching strategy
10. Monitoring and alerting for cache performance
11. Graceful degradation when cache systems fail
12. Cost optimization (balancing cache infrastructure costs vs performance gains)
questions.searchIntent: Designing production caching strategy for e-commerce
questions.realWorldScenario: Real-world e-commerce platform with complex caching requirements, personalization, and multi-region deployment

questions.title: Real-Time Social Media Feed
questions.question:
Design a high-performance, real-time social media feed system with intelligent caching.

Requirements:
- 50 million active users, each follows 500 users on average
- Feed generation: personalized based on follows, engagement, content type preferences
- Real-time updates: new posts should appear in feeds within 2 seconds
- Content types: text posts, images, videos, polls, live streams
- Engagement: likes, comments, shares update in real-time
- Trending topics: algorithmically determined, change every 5 minutes
- Performance targets: feed load <300ms, infinite scroll with <100ms incremental loads
- Scale: 10,000 new posts/second, 100,000 engagement actions/second
- Mobile-first: 85% mobile traffic, need offline capability
- Content ranking: ML-based algorithm considers recency, engagement, user preferences
- Video content: auto-play optimization, bandwidth-aware quality selection
- Privacy: respect user privacy settings and blocked users in cached content

Design:
1. Feed generation and caching architecture (pre-computed vs on-demand)
2. Cache warming strategy for active users
3. Real-time update propagation without cache invalidation storm
4. Handling personalization in cached feeds
5. Optimizing video delivery with adaptive bitrate and CDN
6. Database architecture for feed queries (fan-out on write vs fan-out on read)
7. Caching strategy for trending topics and algorithmic content
8. Pagination and cursor-based feed loading
9. Offline support and client-side caching
10. Handling engagement count updates efficiently
11. Cache consistency between user feed and individual post views
12. Monitoring feed generation performance and cache effectiveness
13. A/B testing infrastructure for feed algorithm changes
questions.searchIntent: Designing real-time feed with caching and performance optimization
questions.realWorldScenario: Production social media platform with real-time feeds, personalization, and massive scale

questions.title: Financial Trading Platform
questions.question:
Design a high-performance caching and optimization strategy for a financial trading platform.

Requirements:
- Real-time stock prices: 10,000 symbols updating every 100ms
- User portfolios: 2 million users, each tracking 10-50 stocks
- Market data: historical prices, charts, technical indicators, news feeds
- Trading operations: buy/sell orders must reflect current prices, no stale data
- Performance requirements: price updates <50ms latency, P99 <100ms for API calls
- Compliance: audit trail for all data served, must be able to prove data accuracy
- Concurrent users: 500,000 during market hours
- Data consistency: portfolio values must be accurate, no eventual consistency for money
- Market data subscriptions: WebSocket connections for real-time price streams
- Analytics: complex queries for portfolio analysis, historical performance
- Mobile app: offline capability for viewing historical data, real-time sync when online
- Peak load: market open/close times see 10x normal traffic

Design:
1. Caching strategy for real-time price data (when/what to cache)
2. Handling price updates and cache invalidation at high frequency
3. WebSocket architecture for real-time price streaming
4. Portfolio value calculation and caching strategy
5. Ensuring data consistency for financial calculations
6. Historical data caching and compression strategy
7. Database architecture for time-series price data
8. Query optimization for complex analytics
9. Handling peak load at market open/close
10. Client-side caching for mobile apps
11. Audit trail and compliance logging without performance impact
12. Graceful degradation when real-time feed is unavailable
13. Monitoring and alerting for data accuracy and latency
14. Disaster recovery and data backup strategy
questions.searchIntent: Designing high-performance trading platform with strict consistency
questions.realWorldScenario: Production financial trading platform with real-time data, strict consistency, and compliance requirements

questions.title: Video Streaming Platform
questions.question:
Design a caching and performance optimization strategy for a video streaming platform (Netflix-like).

Requirements:
- Content library: 50,000 movies/TV shows, 500,000 hours of content
- Users: 100 million subscribers, 20 million concurrent viewers during peak
- Video formats: 4K, 1080p, 720p, 480p with adaptive bitrate streaming
- Content metadata: titles, descriptions, thumbnails, cast info, recommendations
- Personalization: watch history, recommendations, continue watching, profiles
- Geographic distribution: global platform with region-specific content licensing
- Performance targets: video start time <2s, rebuffering <0.5%, quality adaptation smooth
- Bandwidth costs: $10M/month, need to optimize
- New content: weekly releases cause traffic spikes, pre-release buzz
- Search and discovery: search across content, browse by genre, trending content
- Offline downloads: mobile users can download for offline viewing
- Watch party: synchronized viewing with friends (low-latency requirement)

Design:
1. CDN strategy for video content delivery (multi-CDN, edge caching)
2. Video segment caching and pre-loading strategy
3. Adaptive bitrate streaming optimization (when to switch quality)
4. Caching strategy for content metadata and thumbnails
5. Personalization data caching (recommendations, watch history)
6. Optimizing video start time (predictive pre-loading)
7. Handling traffic spikes for new releases
8. Geographic content availability and region-specific caching
9. Database architecture for metadata and user data
10. Search result caching with real-time trending updates
11. Offline download management and storage optimization
12. Watch party synchronization with low latency
13. Bandwidth cost optimization (compression, quality selection)
14. Monitoring playback quality and cache effectiveness
15. A/B testing infrastructure for recommendation algorithms
16. Graceful degradation during CDN failures

questions.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Analytics Platform
questions.question:
Design a high-performance caching strategy for a multi-tenant SaaS analytics platform.

Requirements:
- Tenants: 10,000 companies, ranging from 10 to 50,000 users each
- Data volume: tenants ingest 1TB - 10PB of event data
- Analytics queries: complex aggregations, time-series analysis, custom reports, dashboards
- Real-time dashboards: data freshness <1 minute for real-time metrics
- Historical reports: query years of data, can take 30+ seconds
- Concurrent users: 100,000 users running queries simultaneously
- Query patterns: 80% of queries are repeated (same reports/dashboards)
- Data isolation: strict tenant data isolation for security/compliance
- Performance tiers: premium tenants get dedicated resources and faster queries
- Export functionality: large CSV/Excel exports (millions of rows)
- API access: RESTful API for programmatic data access, rate limited
- Custom dashboards: users create custom queries, unpredictable access patterns

Design:
1. Multi-layer caching strategy (query results, aggregations, raw data)
2. Cache key design for tenant isolation and security
3. Handling different performance tiers (shared vs dedicated caches)
4. Query result caching with parameterization
5. Pre-aggregation and materialized views strategy
6. Real-time data pipeline with caching considerations
7. Database architecture for multi-tenant analytics (shared vs dedicated)
8. Optimizing repeated dashboard queries
9. Handling long-running historical reports
10. Large export generation without impacting real-time queries
11. Cache warming for premium tenants
12. API rate limiting and caching for programmatic access
13. Monitoring cache effectiveness per tenant
14. Cache eviction policies for multi-tenant environment
15. Handling tenant-specific customizations in cached results
16. Cost allocation and optimization per tenant
questions.searchIntent: Designing multi-tenant analytics platform with caching and isolation
questions.realWorldScenario: Production SaaS analytics platform with multi-tenancy, complex queries, and varying performance requirements

questions.title: Ride-Sharing Platform
questions.question:
Design a caching and performance optimization strategy for a ride-sharing platform (Uber-like).

Requirements:
- Scale: 100 million users, 10 million drivers, 20 million rides/day
- Real-time operations: driver locations update every 2 seconds, ride matching in <5s
- Map and routing: map tiles, route calculations, ETA predictions
- Dynamic pricing: surge pricing calculated in real-time based on supply/demand
- Location-based queries: find nearby drivers, estimate arrival time
- Ride history: users and drivers access past rides, receipts, ratings
- Performance targets: app open to ride request <3s, driver matching <5s, P95 API latency <200ms
- Geographic distribution: operates in 500 cities across 50 countries
- Concurrent operations: 1 million active rides simultaneously during peak
- Payment processing: multiple payment methods, transaction history
- Promotions and discounts: personalized offers, referral codes, user-specific pricing
- Safety features: real-time ride tracking, emergency contacts, driver verification

Design:
1. Caching strategy for driver location data (high-frequency updates)
2. Geospatial indexing and query optimization
3. Map tile caching strategy (CDN, client-side, edge)
4. Route calculation caching and pre-computation
5. Surge pricing calculation and caching (balance freshness vs computation cost)
6. Ride matching algorithm optimization
7. Database architecture for location data (time-series, spatial indexes)
8. Historical data caching (ride history, receipts)
9. User session and authentication caching
10. Personalization data caching (preferences, favorite locations)
11. Real-time ride tracking with minimal latency
12. Handling peak load in dense urban areas
13. Multi-region deployment with location-based routing
14. Offline capability for drivers in poor network areas
15. Payment and transaction data caching with security
16. Monitoring location data accuracy and query performance
17. Graceful degradation when real-time systems fail

questions.realWorldScenario: Production ride-sharing platform with real-time location tracking, dynamic pricing, and global scale

questions.title: Healthcare Patient Portal
questions.question:

Requirements:

- Telemedicine: video consultations, chat with doctors, prescription refills
- Compliance: HIPAA compliance, audit logs, data encryption, access controls
- Performance targets: page load <2s, search results <500ms, P99 <1s
- Real-time updates: lab results notification within 1 minute of availability
- Document management: large PDF reports (imaging, test results)
- Prescription management: medication lists, refill requests, pharmacy integration
- Billing and insurance: claims, statements, payment processing
- Mobile app: offline access to essential medical info, sync when online
- Multi-provider access: patients may see multiple doctors across different facilities

Design:
1. Caching strategy with HIPAA compliance (encryption, access controls)
2. User session and authentication caching with security
3. Medical records caching with audit trails
4. Document caching for large PDFs (imaging reports)
5. Real-time notification system for lab results
6. Appointment availability caching (balance freshness vs consistency)
7. Database architecture for medical records (versioning, audit logs)
8. Search optimization for medical records (patient names, conditions, dates)
9. Multi-provider data aggregation and caching
10. Prescription data caching with pharmacy integration
11. Client-side caching for mobile app (secure storage)
12. Cache invalidation for sensitive data updates
13. Handling concurrent access by patient and multiple providers
14. Performance optimization for large document retrieval
15. Monitoring cache access patterns for security anomalies
16. Disaster recovery and data backup with compliance
17. Graceful degradation with patient safety considerations

questions.title: Global Content Management System
questions.question:
Design a high-performance, globally distributed CMS for a major news/media organization.

Requirements:
- Content: 10 million articles, 50 million images, 1 million videos
- Traffic: 500 million page views/month, 10 million unique visitors/day
- Content types: breaking news, articles, live blogs, photo galleries, videos, podcasts
- Geographic distribution: global audience across 100+ countries
- Publishing workflow: journalists create/edit content, editors review/publish
- Real-time updates: breaking news must propagate to all regions in <10 seconds
- Personalization: recommended articles based on reading history, location, preferences
- Search: full-text search across content, trending topics, related articles
- Performance targets: TTFB <200ms globally, page load <1s, 99.99% availability
- Mobile-first: 80% mobile traffic, AMP support, PWA
- Monetization: ads, paywalls, subscription management
- SEO: critical for traffic, need excellent Core Web Vitals
- Multi-language: content in 20+ languages, region-specific editorial

Design:
1. Global CDN strategy (edge caching, multi-CDN)
2. Cache invalidation for breaking news and content updates
3. Caching strategy for authenticated vs anonymous users
4. Handling paywall and subscription verification with caching
5. Image and video optimization for mobile (responsive images, lazy loading)
6. Database architecture for content management (versioning, drafts)
7. Search result caching with real-time trending updates
8. Personalization with high cache hit rates (edge personalization)
9. Multi-language content caching strategy
10. Live blog real-time update propagation
11. Static site generation vs dynamic rendering
12. AMP/PWA caching strategy
13. Ad serving without blocking content rendering
14. Monitoring Core Web Vitals and cache performance
15. Handling traffic spikes for breaking news
16. Geographic content availability and regional caching
17. A/B testing infrastructure for layout/content experiments
18. Cost optimization across global infrastructure
questions.searchIntent: Designing global CMS with edge caching and real-time updates
questions.realWorldScenario: Production news/media CMS with global distribution, real-time updates, and personalization
